title: Fix Cross Language Test Compliance
description: Resolve duplicate logic drift across compose language implementations and restore test compliance. Immediate blocker is C# compile/test failure in compose/net due to recent cross-language refactor drift; fix with minimal parity-preserving changes and re-verify language test suites.
summary:
Fixed cross-language test compliance across all 5 compose implementations:

**Python** (72/72 pass):
- Fixed 30 Python 2-style `except X, Y:` → `except (X, Y):` syntax errors blocking test collection on Python 3.13
- Installed missing trimesh and ifcopenshell dependencies
- Regenerated metabolism.shallow.kit.compose.json fixture (49→50 types to match current kit)
- Updated expected hash to 2ebfdb63f7f1a329702f4c4852c1a7c7c11cf550b74a1f280d7538fc5c25dd0a

**TypeScript** (196/196 pass):
- Fixed null→undefined conversion in deserializeKit JSON.parse reviver for Zod v4 compatibility

**C# net8.0** (71/71 pass):
- Rewrote DefaultComputeChildPlane and MoveTranslationWorldFromPiecePlane from System.Numerics float (32-bit) to double[] arrays (64-bit) for precision parity with THREE.js
- Fixed hash test (removed debug Assert.Fail, updated expected hash)

**Go** (all pass): Updated expected hash in main_test.go
**Rust** (63/63 pass): Updated expected hash in lib.rs
